problems.updated:
# Auto-detect and run all files in tests/ since filenames do not use pytest discovery patterns
test_files = [str(p) for p in (ROOT / "tests").glob("*.py")]
if test_files:
    test_proc = subprocess.run([str(venv_py), "-m", "pytest", "-q"] + test_files, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
problems.fix_explanation: Pytest's default discovery only picks up files named `test_*.py` / `*_test.py`. This repo's test files use `case_*.py`, so `auto_test.py` was updated to pass explicit file paths to pytest so tests are executed in CI runs.
